label: MORNING BRIEF

stories.title: Centenary loans go to 22.5%
stories.story: Centenary Bank will raise its prime lending rate from 20.5% to 22.5% on 19 Dec, for new and existing loans. Stanbic’s mortgage rate goes from 17.5% to 19%.
stories.you: Loan buyers can borrow less. Show them cheaper homes first.

stories.title: PM gives URA 3 days to reopen shops
stories.story: After meeting KACITA, the Prime Minister gave URA three days to reopen traders’ shops and return goods it took. Shops stay shut until then.
stories.you: Shop tenants may reopen soon. Keep talking to them before you let their units go.

stories.title: Shs110bn truck plant opens in Mpigi
stories.story: Museveni and Suluhu opened the Shs110 billion Double Q truck plant on 45 acres at Nakirebe, Mpigi. It employs more than 1,200 people.
stories.you: Workers need homes nearby. List rentals around Nakirebe and Mpigi now.

stories.title: Forged papers in Katanga land case
stories.story: Three people were remanded to Luzira over a forged court document used to claim a Katanga kibanja for 100 people. Some of those named were dead.
stories.you: Selling a kibanja? Meet every seller in person and check any court papers.

stories.title: Railway to the west speeds up
stories.story: Uganda and Tanzania signed a framework for an Isaka–Mpondwe railway through Kikagati, and told officials to speed up studies, designs and funding.
stories.you: Buyers will ask about land near the line. Don’t sell the railway yet — it is still at study stage.
